population.gated: in_percentile_pool ∧ is_outfield ∧ meets_min_minutes (recomputed: minutes_nominal_equiv ≥ 900 − 1e-06, asserted equal on every row)

population.ratio_M: pool outfield rows with denominator ≥ 10; beta-binomial (np_xg_per_shot: variance components); min_attempts = ⌈1.5·M⌉; null when no signal
population.reference: gated rows, one row per (player_id, season_id, source) per population (D3: most minutes, then lowest competition_id, then lowest team_id); for a ratio, only rows meeting min_attempts (ADR 004 D19 clarification, M4c2)
